sprite.name: REVOLVER OCELOT — MGS1
sprite.incarnation: Original 3.2m personalised fully mechanical revolver unit derived from MGS1 Ocelot: tan angular coat-tail hull panels, dark navy/charcoal structural chassis, red throat command housing, silver swept sensor crest and grille abstracting grey ponytail/moustache, mechanical right-arm six-chamber revolver mechanism; no human skin or cloth anatomy and not a released Metal Gear.

sources.scope: Source incarnation identity appearance only; this costume is an original design, not a released canonical costume.

limits: Original costume design has no attested released canonical appearance; absolute canonical 1:1 is not claimed.
Native imagegen output bytes are preserved unchanged. Read-only source geometry is not pixel editing.
All physical pose keys, original UID/actionMap/phaseMap remain inherited; this is not original-game animation extraction.
A manual review and actual Canvas readiness/routing check must finish before runtime registration.
Generated native pixels remain intact; source reviewed against identified canonical reference. This is a faithful 2.5D adaptation, not certified pixel-perfect 1:1 original game footage.
Sixteen actual authored physical keyposes per direction,32 per fighter; action groups explicitly share keyposes. No 72-frame or motion-capture claim.
Canonical identity/outfit/equipment/anatomical sides reviewed; gameplay mechanics, hitboxes and original moves remain authored game adaptations.
Canvas source rectangles and optional vector silhouette clipping isolate native poses without rewriting PNG pixels.
Exactly one drawn revolver per pose, with empty offhand in the punch keypose; Colt barrel/cylinder/hammer silhouette drawn, microscopic engravings approximated at native pose scale.
Full-body outfit source is official painted character art, not extracted final-game animation. Unseen seams/back details inferred.

Source native16-figure templates have only15 distinct rectangles per direction actually referenced by the source action groups. Unused original cell10 is deliberately blank in new artwork; exactly30 generated/used physical bodies, no32-pose claim.
Source-frame heights calibrated from actual standing-body pixels so atlas margin resizing does not change intended costume stature.
This completed whole-frame costume is not a separately articulated/destructible rig. Original design has no released canonical costume attestation.
First native RIGHT/LEFT sheets preserved as rejected border/alpha-separation attempts; accepted independent RIGHT V2 and LEFT V2 repair full limbs and rigid coat-panel margins.
